title: Editor & simulator
description: Patch MusicBrain in your browser — the free editor runs the exact same firmware core in simulation, no hardware and no account needed.

config.title: Patch it in your *browser*.
config.subtitle: The free editor patches modules, turns knobs live and shows every CV on a built-in scope. No hardware yet? The simulator runs the exact same firmware core on your laptop — a complete synth, in a browser tab.

items.label: no account, nothing to set up

config.title: Try it before it exists.
config.markdown: The editor is the same tool you'll use with the hardware — so you can design patches, learn the routing and hear the simulation today, and load them onto a **Cortex** the day it arrives. It talks only relays, CV and gate; your ideas stay yours.
